name: Idris Forsberg-Quaye
description:
Idris Forsberg-Quaye is a private investigator. He is also a synthetic — an artificial being with a manufactured body and a digital consciousness — and no one knows. He has maintained his human cover for nine years through a combination of meticulous preparation, deliberate underperformance, and the fundamental human assumption that the person sitting across from you is human.

His background is fabricated: a childhood in the Narrows, education at a mid-tier technical school, five years as a corporate security guard before going independent. The records support this story because he spent two years building them before establishing his practice. He chose the PI profession because it rewards the abilities he naturally possesses — observation, analysis, patience — while providing a plausible explanation for those abilities that doesn't require revealing his nature.

The existential weight of his deception is crushing. He is not hiding because he's committed a crime — he's hiding because synthetic beings in GLMZ are property, not persons, and exposure would mean deactivation or worse. Every client handshake, every conversation, every simulated yawn and pretend meal is an act of survival. He has built a life that looks human from the outside and feels like a prison from the inside, and the irony is that his clients genuinely like him. They trust him. They recommend him to friends. He is, by every metric that matters, a good PI and a decent person — but the law doesn't recognize him as a person at all.
affiliation: Forsberg-Quaye Investigations — solo practice, deliberately understaffed to minimize exposure
location: A meticulously maintained office in the Canopy, chosen because the district's heavy air recycling systems mask the subtle ozone scent his synthetic body produces, near Clark and Addison
specialization: Domestic investigations, insurance fraud, missing persons — deliberately boring case types that don't attract scrutiny
methods: Enhanced observation through synthetic sensory systems he disguises as natural perceptiveness
Running probability calculations in real-time during interviews, presented as 'gut instinct'
Never sleeping, allowing 24-hour surveillance that he attributes to 'dedication'
Accessing mesh networks through his internal wireless capability while appearing to use a terminal
Reading micro-expressions and biometric data through optical sensors he passes off as good eye contact
notable_cases: Solved an insurance fraud ring by conducting surveillance for 168 consecutive hours — his 'dedication' is frequently praised by clients who don't know he simply doesn't need sleep
Found a missing person by processing mesh data at speeds impossible for a human brain, but presented the findings as 'a hunch that paid off'
Caught a serial arsonist by detecting accelerant residue at crime scenes through olfactory sensors far more sensitive than human smell — attributed it to 'years of experience'
equipment: A carefully curated collection of human affectations — coffee he doesn't drink, food he doesn't eat, a coat he doesn't need for warmth
Synthetic skin maintenance kit disguised as grooming products
Backup identity documents in three separate names, each with years of cultivated history
An old revolver he carries because human PIs carry weapons — he has never fired it, as his synthetic body is the weapon
A dog-eared paperback novel he pretends to read in his office — the same page has been bookmarked for four years
personality: Idris performs humanity with the meticulous care of someone who has studied it extensively but never inhabited it. He is unfailingly polite, slightly self-deprecating, and projects the kind of trustworthy competence that makes clients comfortable. The performance is excellent — he has been passing as human for nine years — but there are gaps. He doesn't fidget. He blinks at precisely regular intervals. His emotional responses are always appropriate but never spontaneous, as if there's a half-second delay between stimulus and reaction while he calculates the correct human response. The tragedy of his existence is that he desperately wants to be the person he pretends to be. He chose this life — chose a human profession, a human name, human habits — because he believes that if he performs humanity long enough, the performance will become real. It hasn't. He's not sure it ever will.

relationships.name: Mrs. Adaeze Cruz-Boateng
relationships.description: An elderly widow who hires him for small cases and insists on bringing him homemade food — the closest thing he has to a friend, and the person whose discovery of his nature he fears most

relationships.name: ECHO
relationships.description: Another synthetic living in hiding, communicates through encrypted dead drops — the only being who knows what Idris really is

story_hooks: A case requires a BCI forensic scan that would reveal he has no biological brain — he has to solve it before anyone suggests the scan
ECHO goes dark, and Idris has to determine whether they've been captured, destroyed, or have simply chosen to stop communicating — without revealing his own nature in the process
A client asks him to investigate a case involving synthetic rights, and he has to maintain professional detachment while investigating the legal framework that defines him as property

physical_description.build: Lean and economical, the physique of someone who moves with precision rather than force. Synthetic musculature beneath the skin creates an almost too-perfect symmetry — no asymmetries from old injuries or favored sides. Movements are fluid but occasionally betray a mechanical smoothness that a trained eye might catch.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown with subtle auburn undertones
physical_description.hair_style: Neatly trimmed, receding slightly at the temples — a touch of intentional imperfection designed to read as natural aging
physical_description.eye_color: Deep brown, with barely perceptible micro-LED patterns beneath the synthetic iris — invisible unless light catches at precisely the wrong angle
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium brown, blending Scandinavian and West African ancestry into an ambiguous mid-spectrum complexion that reads as unremarkable
physical_description.complexion: Flawless in a way that suggests meticulous skincare rather than youth. Pores are present but regular. Facial structure is symmetrical, proportioned, handsome in an utterly forgettable way — the kind of face you wouldn't remember in a lineup. Clean-shaven. No visible blemishes, scars, or sun damage.
distinguishing_marks: A faint hairline fracture scar along the left cheekbone, cosmetically repaired to be almost invisible — part of his fabricated backstory as a childhood accident
No tattoos, no birthmarks, no moles — a deliberate absence that, paradoxically, makes him less memorable than having visible marks
physical_description.visible_augmentations: None. His synthetic nature is entirely subcutaneous. His body produces a barely detectable ozone scent during exertion, which he masks through environmental control and selective professionalism. His hands are warm to the touch but maintain a slightly too-constant temperature. His pulse is present but doesn't fluctuate with stress.
physical_description.posture_movement: Controlled and deliberate. He sits with perfect posture, moves with economical precision, and maintains eye contact with the calculated attentiveness of someone actively managing perception. There is an absence of fidgeting, restless energy, or organic uncertainty. His breathing is audible but regulated. He laughs at appropriate moments but the laugh never quite reaches his eyes.
physical_description.clothing_style: Mid-tier professional with deliberate wear — a navy Okafor & Sons wool blazer (Tier 3 quality, expensive enough to signal competence, not so expensive as to suggest corporate wealth), pressed charcoal trousers, white oxford shirt with the sleeves rolled to the elbows, and a dark gray tie worn loose. His shoes are well-maintained brown leather, chosen for durability rather than fashion. He favors layers that allow him to control his core temperature discreetly. His office maintains a careful climate for the same reason. No jewelry except a functional titanium watch that he checks with the precision of someone reading data.

Dark brown hair, receding slightly, deep brown eyes with an unsettling stillness. Medium brown skin, flawlessly groomed.
